domain: A1-S2: SU(2)xSU(2) subset G_2 CAS implementations
oneLineSummary: NO CAS auto-discovers 6-dim SU(2)xSU(2) subalgebra from 14 G_2 matrices. Standard algorithm = HARDCODE octonion-Cayley split (Draper arXiv:1704.07819 Sec on G_2 via para-units). Ground-truth check: 7=(2,2)+(1,3) branching.
recommendation: Sage WeylCharacterRing('G2') + branching_rule (only single A_1 registered, need manual compose); LieART 2.0 has tabulated branching; basisgen Python supports G_2 weights but no subgroup decomposition; GAP Lie algebra chapter 64 has matrices but no built-in search. For matrices: use Draper-Fontanals Cayley-split construction. ALGORITHM IS HARDCODE, not blind search.
caveats: PyG2 does NOT exist as maintained package. davidsd/lie + custom NumPy code is fastest path. SymPy + Sage WeylCharacterRing OK for symbolic verification.
